newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 15.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ended up 1.16 points at 7,922.98.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended 2.11 points lower at 1,015.50.
* Ringgit continues to fall on Tuesday morning, hitting a 33-month low at 2.57/dollar in early hours.
* Interest rates, which continued to surge on Monday, expected to remain high.

* "There should be less volatility. At least people have a clear idea that ringgit is most likely weaker and interest rates will remain high," said Ralph Dixon, a dealer in the international division of TA Securities.
* Dealers said local institutions expected to continue buying select shares on Tuesday after two days of providing support to the sagging market.

* Hospital Pantai Bhd to requote after announcing a four-for-one bonus issue and scrapping a four million share issue. It is planning to shift to the main board from the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
